For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?
Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall…
Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”

Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

translations.web: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
translations.bsb: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher, “futility of futilities! Everything is futile!”
translations.kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
translations.asv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher; vanity of vanities, all is vanity.
